versions.changelog:
- Initial release of seo-blog-writer (v1.0.0).
- Enables users to generate SEO-optimized blog content, outlines, meta descriptions, and product descriptions.
- Offers structured blog outlines (H1/H2/H3), keyword optimization, and internal linking suggestions.
- Pro version available with complete SEO workflow, multiple content frameworks, keyword mapping templates, on-page checklist, and more.
- Pro users also receive Python scripts, bulk content processing, ready-to-use files, and lifetime access via Telegram (@Cofi_ClawSkill_Bot).
